name: Untangle the Internet
summary: Untangle The Internet is a first-person cable management game set in a huge data center, where every cable in the world lies in one giant heap on the floor. Players pull cables out of the pile, carry each plug to its addressed port and connect both ends, turning the tangle into neat, permanent cable runs. Each connected cable earns bytes to spend at the shop on tools such as the Heap Rake, Magnet, Port Scanner, Cable Cart and zip ties. As the hall fills up, services come back online one by one and the dark hall slowly lights up again. It can be played solo or in online co-op with up to 6 players.
